title: Line sketch: Japanese Landscape Screen
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A traditional Japanese folding screen composition depicting a serene lakeside landscape with rolling hills, distant snow-capped mountains, and a winding river under a sky.
